versions.changelog:
Initial release of ui-final-polish skill for final visual refinement of existing UI (not redesign).

- Applies focused, surgical visual polish after structure is established.
- Prioritizes improvements in hierarchy, spacing, alignment, and readability.
- Strictly preserves existing design direction, component role, and visual style.
- Provides clear rules for what to fix, what to avoid, and how much to change.
- Guides users to use pencil-ui-structure for structural changes before polish.
